why: Part 1 of the 0602 amendment (plan body 3e7221f27992): P2 leaves every related leg, the receipt keeps only on main's ref and reads the runner's own variables, check.yaml drops the receipt and archive steps and keeps the consumer fault, record.ts returns to its parent's bytes. scheduled.yaml and its guard wait for ticket 1161.
note: 51 plants on the real files, one run each, 47 red at first. Four were not: two refusal and stage-key checks had no case, so two were added and are now red; P2 back by path stayed green only on the 12-run process law, and scenario cases carry it; two guard conditions duplicated R1's command list, so they were removed and a plant on the list is red. The rows above are a sample of the 51. Also ported 1589's select(files, sizing) cases to 1618's select(event, lists, sizing), which the merge commit had not.
